description: Restore a side page's draft to a prior version. Find valid version IDs via list_side_page_versions. This only changes the DRAFT — it moves currentVersionId forward to a new version copied from the target (forward history is never deleted). The live/public page is unaffected until you publish again via set_side_page_state({ published: true }).

sideKey.description: Side page key — the slug as returned by list_side_pages. A nested key containing "/" (e.g. "features/feature-1") is passed as-is; the server handles the URL encoding.

versionId.description: Numeric version ID from list_side_page_versions to restore as the draft

name: restore_side_page_version
